answer: Seed the grading queue with decoys. Each epoch the ledger slips in answers it wrote itself, one known junk and one known strong, hidden behind a cipher so graders can't tell them from real work. A sybil ring that rubber-stamps its own members also misgrades the decoys, and the gap between its scores and the truth opens like a canyon. Missing two decoys in ten epochs costs an identity its grading seat and half its locked stake, so a farm of 100 puppets needs falcon-sharp review on every seat or pays 100 times.
